comparator.name: Bachelor International Business Administration
comparator.route: Navigating stakeholders in global business track
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official IBA programme is a three-year, 180-EC English-taught bachelor. The first two years provide a structured international foundation across business functions, research methods, law, innovation, technology and responsible leadership. Year 3 combines 30 EC of exchange, internship, minor or project choice space with advanced research and methods, Doing International Business the Dutch Way, one of three elective tracks, and a track-aligned bachelor project. Navigating stakeholders in global business is selected neutrally as the broadest general international-business route.

alternatives.label: International business, management & stakeholders
alternatives.concept: A broad international-business pathway focused on management, strategy, entrepreneurship, markets, leadership and responsible stakeholder relations.
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum spans the main business functions while emphasising strategy, leadership, entrepreneurship and cross-border stakeholder management.
progression: Business, economics, data and research foundations precede advanced strategy, law, leadership, econometrics and market research; all formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: International business, AI & digital innovation
alternatives.concept: An AI for a connected world direction combining international business with data, digital operations, machine learning, AI ethics and technology strategy.
alternatives.labelReason: Business foundations are combined with programming, data science, algorithms, machine learning, neural networks and AI governance to represent the official AI track responsibly.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest route, this pathway replaces several leadership and entrepreneurship courses with programming, databases, algorithms, machine learning, neural networks and AI optimisation, creating a clear digital-technology centre.
progression: Programming and mathematical foundations precede algorithms, machine learning, neural networks and optimisation. Business and research foundations precede advanced strategy and analytical work. All prerequisites and semester offerings are respected.

alternatives.label: International accounting, finance & analytics
alternatives.concept: An accounting and finance direction combining international business foundations with financial reporting, banking, econometrics, behavioural economics and analytical decision-making.
alternatives.labelReason: Accounting, banking, economics, econometrics, quantitative methods and business decision-making create a coherent international finance direction without claiming a professional accountancy qualification.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the broad closest match and the sustainability route, this curriculum substitutes mathematics, programming, databases, optimisation, probability and additional economics/finance for much of the leadership, marketing, communication and sustainability content.
progression: Programming and mathematical methods precede decision algorithms, linear algebra and probability; economics and research foundations precede advanced economics, econometrics, finance and market research, with all formal prerequisites completed earlier and all courses offered in their assigned terms.

routeSelection.route: Navigating stakeholders in global business track
routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is generic International Business Administration. The current official programme lists three elective tracks. Navigating stakeholders in global business most broadly continues the programme’s international management and strategy identity and is selected independently of UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest curriculum covers international business, management, strategy, marketing, entrepreneurship, sustainability, leadership and stakeholder relations. The two remaining official track directions—AI for a connected world and Accounting and finance for international business—are coherent, feasible and materially distinct. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.

notes.text: UCR can create strong interdisciplinary international-business pathways but cannot reproduce IBA’s continuous multinational-company project work, guaranteed global cohort experience, dedicated supply-chain sequence, professional internship infrastructure or track-specific supervised bachelor project.
